slice: Bind retained workflow trigger gate and its dependency contract into the commit-bound GitHub Actions test workflow.

constraints_respected: No payment or conversion logic added to Vercel.
No GitHub files or history deleted.

rollback.method: Revert the three commits in reverse order without deleting history.

next_action: Obtain an artifact-bearing successful workflow run for the exact commit through authenticated exhaustive enumeration, then inspect and retain the eleven-source checksum manifest before allowing evidence promotion.
